steps.content: The weekend weather is splendid, with the clear skies carrying not a wisp of cloud. Even the gentle breeze is adorned with the faint scent of newly bloomed flowers.
Noon is the busiest time of the day, and the streets teem with bustling crowds. Despite having to regularly soothe herself with water, Lore-Ley doesn't want to miss any of the views before her.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: I read online before that the human eye has a higher resolution than any camera, and it's true! Look at the foliage under the sunlight! Such a beautiful green! Online pics can't compare to the real thing at all!
At first, she trailed behind you timidly, but now she's running around like an excited critter bursting with curiosity for everything around her.
She skips along under the shade of the trees, where light specks fall through the canopy and sparkle on her feet with each step.
Even a trivial thing like this is enough to make her happy for quite a while.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Hmm... If feels a bit suffocating to walk under those tall buildings. This isn't what they call "megalophobia," is it?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Look! The birds are standing in a row on the wire... Ah, they all flew away.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: A leaf has fallen off the branch over there! I can definitely catch it before it hits the ground!
She would suddenly stop and inhale the floral scent in the air, then eagerly share with you the subtle differences between the flowers on this street and the last.
She would also crouch by the greenery to touch the soil, buds, and cement pavement on the other side, then carefully compare their differences.
She sniffs her soil-stained fingers and reflects to herself.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: It feels slick and cool, but it smells like this? It's different from what I imagined...
Hearing her mumbling to herself, you squat down beside her and rub some soil with your fingertips.
If it were a rainy day, the smell would change again.
Your childish actions draw curious glances from onlookers, but you don't mind. You listen to her intently and respond accordingly.
Immersed in her own world, Lore-Ley is talking a lot more. After years of being confined in a tub, things that are ordinary to most people are a brand new experience for her.

This might be the first time in her life she can truly step into, observe, and explore this vast world. You want her to experience as much as possible during this meaningful opportunity, and not let any of her expectations fall short.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Change again? To what? I often saw people online say they like the "smell of soil after the rain," but what kind of smell is that exactly?
Hmm... I guess it's a moist smell?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: What does "moist" smell like? Is it the same as the smell of wet clothes?
She continues to ask, but this question stumps you. You're not sure how to answer, so you awkwardly scratch your head.
Uh... It's hard to explain in words. How about we wait for a rainy day and then come out to smell it together?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Sure, I'll remember that!!
She nods vigorously, her smile bright and vivid. She summons her cute little manta ray and solemnly jots down the promise between you and her.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: ...Huh? Could that be...!
Attracted by something else, Lore-Ley gasps and dashes across the street by herself, quickly disappearing into the bustling crowd.
Wait...
You venture into the crowd after her, looking around until you finally see that tuft of light blue hair by the window of a pet store.

As you approach, you see Lore-Ley gazing intently at a puppy behind the window. She glides her finger against the glass, and the white furball chases her finger back and forth, wagging its tail happily.
Looks like it really likes you.
Hearing your words, she flashes a bashful smile.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: I've watched a lot of cat and dog videos online, but I've never seen them in real life. They seem even livelier and cuter than in the videos.
Want to take a look? Maybe you can even pet them if the staff allows.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: ...Really!?
Her eyes light up as she looks at you, brimming with joy and anticipation. You smile and nod.
Of course.
The pet store owner kindly agrees to your request. After cleaning your hands and clothes as requested, you're allowed into the activity area.
In a sunlit corner of the activity area, you sit quietly and observe the girl play happily with the puppy.
The puppy energetically barks and jumps, eagerly fetching the ball again and again. Lore-Ley can't help but laugh when the puppy licks her fingers.
After a while, the puppy gets tired and falls asleep on Lore-Ley's lap. Lore-Ley strokes the puppy's white fur, murmuring to herself.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: So this is what touching an animal feels like. Warm, dry, fluffy, and very soft... so different from my skin, which is always cold and slippery from the water.
You watch her quietly look at her lap, not knowing what she's pondering about. So you decide to ask.
What are you thinking about?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Ada also had a puppy like this one.
Ada?
Lore-Ley snaps back to her senses, as if realizing what she just said. She stops petting the puppy for a moment, but the puppy whines and she continues.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Ada... was a friend I met online a long time ago.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: I met her through a game. Her username was "Ada - Top Future Designer of the Universe." We were on the same team several times. Her skills were on par with mine, so we became familiar with each other over time.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Gradually, we started to talk more, and discussed things beyond gaming. She shared her life and the things happening around her with me.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Like what she had for dinner, the weird trees and clouds she saw in the street, the stress of graduating, her favorite stars and cartoons, and her dream of becoming a top designer...
Lore-Ley's lips curl into a faint smile. For her, those memories are as soft and cute as the puppy resting on her lap.
She seems to be a brave, honest and interesting person to have written her dream in her username like that for everyone to see.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Yeah. Ada was straightforward, confident, and generous.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: No matter what kind of injustice or discomfort she encountered, she would boldly express her feelings and then bravely resist.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Once, she told me she had a big fight with her parents because they were too controlling. They meddled in everything, and she had no personal space.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: I told her that my parents don't really interact with me that much now, and I kind of envy her for having that kind of attention.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: She seemed unable to understand my point of view. It was the first time I mentioned my health condition to her...

The moisture on Lore-Ley's body has gradually dried up. She wants to pour the water in her bottle on herself, but is unwilling to leave the critters in the activity area, so she just takes a sip of water instead.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: She apologized, saying that she didn't realize what situation I was in. Then she sent me a picture of the puppy she just adopted.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: She told me the puppy was named Cabbage, and had just turned one year old. He had a heart condition, but was well cared for and took his medicine regularly.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Cabbage was very bubbly and knew how to cheer people up. Everyone who met him liked him.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Ada said she would send me videos of her playing with Cabbage every day. Seeing their joy made me happy, too. She said if I ever felt lonely, they would be my friends.
What happened after?
Lore-Ley flashes a bitter smile and shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Nothing. I lost contact with her a long time ago.
The puppy that resembles the one in Lore-Ley's memory senses her melancholy. It opens its eyes and goes forward to lick her cheek.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Our last chat was probably in the summer five or six years ago. I still remember the last message she sent me. She said she was going on a family trip and would send me photos when she got back.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: But after that, her avatar never lit up again. I never saw Cabbage again.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: But isn't that how online friends are? You connect randomly and hit it off quickly, but as time passes, or as your shared interest fades, the connection naturally breaks.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: After all, a "friendship" built on an internet cable can't be that strong.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: But I do miss those times. I felt like I had a faraway friend. Sometimes when I reminisce, I wonder how she is now, and whether she realized her dream of becoming a designer...
You purse your lips.
Why not try contacting her again?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: What...?
Lore-Ley looks at you, somewhat surprised.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Are you saying...
In your current state, finding Ada's contact info shouldn't be hard, right?
You make a typing gesture, but she seems a bit startled by your suggestion and hesitantly waves her hands.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Th-that might not be a good idea... Isn't it a bit too sudden...
What if she wants to know how you're doing too, but just hasn't found the chance or courage to take the initiative?
You don't want to live in regret forever, do you? Don't you want to change things?
Lore-Ley bites her lip and falls silent for a while before speaking softly.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: I know her. If she wanted to do something, she'd definitely do it right away...

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Maybe we just weren't fated to be...
But that's just your guess, right? You still have to ask her directly to get a definite answer, don't you?
Just like how you got a definite answer from the guests before bringing them to the bottom of the sea.
Lore-Ley pouts at you, deep in thought. Having no intention of letting her back out, you continue to push her.
Whether one wants to create, maintain, or keep a connection, one side must bravely take the first step.
After an intense internal struggle, Lore-Ley finally nods as if she's made up her mind.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Then... I'll give it a try. I can... find her social media account and make a call.
She takes a comms device out of her pocket, activates her power, and quickly finds Ada's number from the vast sea of information on the internet. With trembling fingers, she presses the dial button.
Beep—Beep—
Her heart beats intensely to every ring, and the sweat of her palm almost makes her drop the device.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: ...Hello?

The call finally connects. Seeing Lore-Ley's panicked expression, you know she must have recognized the voice. But the background on the other side is very noisy, full of boisterous clamor and clanging.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Who is it? Hello?
The voice on the other end grows impatient, and Lore-Ley, flustered, casts a pleading look at you.
You gently squeeze her little finger and make a "relax" gesture to Lore-Ley. Under your encouraging gaze, she gradually calms down, takes a deep breath, and bravely speaks.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Hello, is this Ada?

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: Yes. Who is this?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Um... I'm L.L., do you remember me?
Ada clicks her tongue, her voice full of wariness and irritation.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: I don't know anyone named L.L., and I'm not interested in buying anything. Go bother someone else...

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Wait, wait! I'm not selling anything! We met online in a game a long time ago. My gamertag was L.L.! We used to chat every day! You showed your puppy and said we could all be friends!

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: We haven't been in touch for a long time... I just wanted to know, are you... doing okay?
Lore-Ley pours out everything she wants to say in one breath. Her shoulders rise and fall intensely, as if she's used up all her strength.
The other side listens to Lore-Ley and falls silent for a moment.

steps.speaker: Ada
steps.content: I don't know why you're calling me. We're not friends, and whether I'm okay or not has nothing to do with you. Don't call again.
There's a noticeable change in her attitude. She seems to recall Lore-Ley but hangs up quickly as if avoiding something.
Beep, beep, beep...
Lore-Ley stares at the coldly beeping comms device, somewhat at a loss.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: ...I knew this is how it would end.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Online friends are just online friends, after all. Without ever meeting offline, it's wishful thinking to be real friends...
As she wallows in the pain and disappointment of rejection, you carefully recall the brief call, troubled by the noise in the background.
How noisy the background was when you called her? It sounded like people were arguing.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: It did sound a bit noisy... I also heard a loud clang. Not sure what it was.
Was something getting smashed?
Lore-Ley's expression changes a bit.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Did something happen on her end? Could she be in danger? Is that why she didn't answer me directly?!
It's possible...
Lore-Ley, can you locate her based on that phone call just now?

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Yeah.
She nods and closes her eyes as she holds the device. Countless data flashes before her eyes.

steps.speaker: Lore-Ley
steps.content: Found it! She's very close! It's a neighborhood about two kilometers from here!
Okay, let's head over there.
